newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: API says ASX listing on June 16.
newsitem.headline: API says ASX listing on June 16.

text.p: Pharmaceutical wholesaler Australian Pharmaceutical Industries Ltd (API) said its compliance listing on the Australian Stock Exchange (ASX) would be on Monday, June 16.
The listing follows shareholder acceptance of a board proposal to restructure the company's capital base at an extraordinary general meeting in April.
"Our sales in May, the first month of our new financial year, were over 20 percent above last year," group managing director Ron Rowland said in a statement.
He said API was well placed to break the A$1 billion sales barrier in the financial year.

"During the last twelve months, without counting acquisitions, we have more than doubled the growth produced by our competitors on a national basis. Our national market share is now 26.3 percent and the management team is committed to capturing 30 percent nationally by the end of April next year," Rowland said.
